blurb: At Camping Oceanic, our goal is simple. Relaxed camping, clean surroundings, and friendly service.Guests enjoy a heated pool, playgrounds, sports courts, a bouncy pillow, and a full schedule of weekend activities. The campground sits just minutes from the shore of Parlee Beach and close to shops and town attractions in Shediac.
